'''Upgrade Defense''' is a hero action that allows players to spend [[mana]] to upgrade a nearby defense, increasing its stats and fully [[Repair Defense|repairing]] it. The action's default hotkey is [5] on PC.

== Costs ==
A single defense can be upgraded up to five times, with every level requiring more mana and a longer [[Hero Casting Rate|casting period]] to complete. In order to fully upgrade a tower, the active hero must be at least level 60.

== Target Priority ==
On PC, the player's cursor will be automatically placed over an upgradable defense in range when this ability is activated. If there is more than one valid target, the least upgraded and closest defense is prioritized. Additionally, Tower Buff Beams are prioritized over all other defenses.
In Vanilla, this priority can be adjusted through a config file inside the game's folders.

== Other Methods ==
* The [[Adept]] has an [[Upgrade Aura]] {{Version|vanilla}}/[[Instant Upgrade]] {{Version|redux}} ability that lets her upgrade defenses instantly, for a higher mana cost. This upcharge depends on her ''Ability 1'' stat.
* The [[Jester|Jester's]] [[Wheel O' Fortuna]] has two combinations that either upgrade (or downgrade) the closest applicable defense.
* Friendly [[Djinn]] in the challenges [[War of the Djinn]] and [[Rumble in the Jungle]] occasionally upgrade on their own.
* The [[Upgrader Djinnlet]] {{Version|redux}} automatically spends the hero's mana to upgrade nearby defenses for a 50% upcharge.

== In Other Dungeon Defenders Games ==
''[[Dungeon Defenders: Awakened|Awakened]]'' has a more sophisticated upgrade priority system by default than DD1 on PC.
